story.iWant: check and configure database service environment
story.soThat: data storage services can run properly
story.tasks: - Task 1: Redis Service Detection and Configuration (AC: 1) - Create RedisServiceManager class in services/redis_service_manager.py - Implement Windows Redis service detection (sc query, netstat) - Implement macOS Redis service detection (brew services) - Implement Linux Redis service detection (systemctl, service) - Add Redis connection testing and configuration validation - Task 2: PostgreSQL Service Detection and Configuration (AC: 2) - Create PostgreSQLServiceManager class in services/postgresql_service_manager.py - Implement PostgreSQL version detection and compatibility checking - Add PostgreSQL connection testing and authentication validation - Implement cross-platform PostgreSQL service detection - Add PostgreSQL configuration file management - Task 3: Docker Environment Integration (AC: 3) - Create DockerManager class in services/docker_manager.py - Implement Docker installation detection and version checking - Add Docker container status detection for Redis and PostgreSQL - Implement Docker container startup and management - Add Docker volume and network configuration - Task 4: Database Configuration Management (AC: 4) - Create DatabaseConfigurator class in core/database_configurator.py - Implement automatic port detection and conflict resolution - Add secure password generation and management - Implement data directory configuration and permissions - Create configuration file templates and management - Task 5: Database Installation Options (AC: 5) - Create DatabaseInstaller class in services/database_installer.py - Implement local database installation (Redis, PostgreSQL) - Add Docker-based database installation - Create installation method selection interface - Add installation progress tracking and error handling - Task 6: Integration Testing - Create comprehensive unit tests for all database managers - Test database service detection across different platforms - Validate Docker container management functionality - Test database configuration generation and validation - Add integration tests for complete database setup workflow

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Detect Redis service status, supporting Windows services, macOS Brew services, Linux systemd services 2. Detect PostgreSQL service status, verifying connection capability and version compatibility 3. Implement Docker environment detection, supporting Docker container startup for database services 4. Automatically configure database connection parameters (ports, passwords, data directories) 5. Provide database service installation options (local installation vs Docker containers)

docs.doc: Defines 5 acceptance criteria for database environment configuration: detect Redis service status, detect PostgreSQL service status, implement Docker environment detection, auto-configure database connection parameters, provide database service installation options.
Provides detailed database and Redis environment variable configuration, including SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL connection configuration, and Redis connection pool configuration.
Provides installation patterns, progress tracking systems, and error handling patterns that can be used for database service installation implementation.

docs.doc: Provides dependency checking architecture and status detection patterns that can be reused for database service detection.

code.code: Configuration manager with INI format support, platform-specific overrides, and global singleton pattern. Provides get(), set(), save(), load_platform_overrides() methods. Reusable for database configuration management.
Real-time progress tracking with step weight calculation, status management (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED), and time statistics. Reusable for database installation progress tracking.

Comprehensive installation verification with version compatibility checking, functional verification, performance benchmarking, and detailed verification report generation. Design pattern reusable for database verification.

Cross-platform OS detection with Windows, macOS, Linux support, architecture detection (x64, ARM64, x86), and version compatibility checking. Essential for platform-specific database service management.
Dependency checking with version detection and comparison, path validation, minimum version requirements checking, and executable finding. Pattern reusable for database service detection.

Environment detection including system info, development environment detection (Python, Node.js, Git, Redis), port occupancy status, and network connection status. Already includes Redis detection - extendable for other databases.
Network connection detection, proxy configuration detection, package manager reachability checking, and offline mode detection. Usable for database connection testing.
Empty service file (1 line) - placeholder for database service implementation to be created as part of this story.

tests.standards: Testing follows pytest framework with comprehensive unit and integration test coverage. Tests use proper mocking to avoid actual system interactions. Test structure includes Test* classes with descriptive test methods, markers for test categorization (unit, integration, slow, windows, posix), and assertions for cross-platform compatibility. All tests maintain 100% code coverage with proper error scenario testing.
